name: University of Melbourne
summary: Parkville campus close to Melbourne's centre; a broad degree of Arts, Science, Commerce or Biomedicine with over 100 study areas to choose from.

ib.text: Each degree sets an IB total: 27 for Arts, 31 Science, 34 Commerce and Biomedicine, 37 Oral Health, plus English and maths or science at a grade 4. Predicted grades are accepted for a conditional offer.

dates.label: Mid-year intake 2027 (Semester 2, July): direct applications close

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A flexible first year lets you sample science, biomedicine, maths, engineering and IT subjects before you choose one of more than 40 majors; electives in business, languages and communication sit alongside.
programmes.ib: Indicative entry score of 31 IB points; maths grade 4 (AA SL/HL or AI HL) and one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics at grade 4, plus English.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the published entry score; predicted grades give a conditional offer.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science: flexible first year and more than 40 majors across science, engineering, IT and maths

programmes.name: Bachelor of Biomedicine
programmes.about: A health-science degree taught beside the Melbourne Biomedical Precinct, with 40+ hospitals and research institutes nearby; the usual route to graduate medicine, dentistry, physiotherapy or research.
programmes.ib: Indicative entry score of 34 IB points; Chemistry required, maths grade 4 (AA SL/HL or AI HL), plus English.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the published entry score; predicted grades give a conditional offer.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Biomedicine: in the biomedical precinct with more than 40 hospitals, institutes and organisations

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: Bachelor of Arts: IB 27 and English; maths at grade 4 is advised if you want to major in Economics.

faculties.name: Faculty of Business and Economics
faculties.line: Bachelor of Commerce: IB 34, English and maths at grade 4 (AA SL/HL or AI HL).

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Bachelor of Science: IB 31, maths and a science at grade 4. Agriculture: IB 25 with maths at grade 4.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Biomedicine: IB 34 with Chemistry and maths. Oral Health: IB 37 with Biology or Chemistry.

faculties.name: Faculty of Architecture, Building and Planning
faculties.line: Bachelor of Design: IB 29 and English; no specific subject beyond English is listed.

notes: The IB entry-score page lists nine undergraduate degrees; careers such as medicine, dentistry and physiotherapy are reached after a degree like Biomedicine or Science.
The applications page says mid-year 2027 direct applications close 31 May 2027, but each course page says 31 March 2027; apply by the earlier date.
IB students outside Australia and New Zealand apply direct to the university for either intake; VTAC is only for IB students in Australia or New Zealand.
